svg.title: The Pirsig logo: the kanji 無 (mu, no thing) brushed in its twelve strokes inside an open ensō, by @h0ffmann, rendered from its Desmos expressions
svg.desc: Blue: the geometry, cubic Béziers through hand-placed points, each piece at its brush width. Orange: each expression of pirsig.desmos.json, sampled.
